subject: Post-demo: StratusGrid evaluation — success criteria & integration next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@stratusgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have a single plan to share with your team.

High-level goal
- Validate Redwood's streaming + tool-calling capabilities for StratusGrid's ingest pipeline and real-time enrichment use case.

Success criteria (what your team told us matters)
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency <= 150ms for 512-token sequences under the pilot workload.
- Throughput: sustained 200 rps across a 3-node dedicated pool (or equivalent hosted config).
- Quality: automated score on your benchmark prompts >= 0.88 (we'll run the eval harness you shared).
- Reliability: graceful fallback to smaller model without dropping requests when capacity spikes.

Proposed POC structure (3-week trial)
- Week 0 (prep, align): exchange test accounts, security questionnaire items, and ingestion sample (1 day).
- Week 1 (integration): SDK + streaming routes, tool-calling stub, run smoke tests (3 working days).
- Week 2 (load & evaluation): run 2 load curves + eval harness, iterate config (5 working days).
- Week 3 (acceptance & handoff): review metrics, sign acceptance, agree next steps (2–3 days).

Ownership & roles
- Redwood: Diego (technical lead), Ben (success metrics / billing), Marissa (commercial/contract).
- StratusGrid: Emma (product), Sarah O'Neil (security), Tom Nguyen (engineering).

Technical asks from your side
- Dedicated test account credentials or a VPN endpoint for private deployment verification.
- Representative sample of ingest messages (anonymized) and target eval prompts.
- Your security point-of-contact for SOC2 evidence and data-retention questions.

Attachments I am dropping in this thread: stratus_integration_sketch.pdf (integration sketch) and redwood_sdk_routebook.md (SDK usage + example endpoints). I also attached a SOW draft for the POC as a starting point.

Next steps
1) Please confirm POC start window — we proposed Aug 1.
2) Can Sarah be looped into the security thread so we can get SOC2 materials?
3) Emma/Tom: share the sample ingest and a short list of acceptance prompts by EOD Thu.

If that's agreeable I'll send a calendar invite for an Aug 1 kickoff and circulate the technical checklist so engineering can start stub work.

Thanks —
Diego

Diego Fernandez
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Diego.Fernandez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0118

Attachments: stratus_integration_sketch.pdf (diagram), redwood_sdk_routebook.md (text), SOW-draft-stratus-2028-07.pdf (proposal)

Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed POC plan

Diego —

Appreciate the clear summary, and the timeline looks good to us. A few clarifications from our side: 

- POC start: Aug 1 works. Can we do the kickoff at 10:00am PT that day?
- Security: looping in Sarah; she will own SOC2 / data-retention checks. Sarah, I'll let you take it from here — we need the SOC2 Type II report and specifics about data deletion after the POC.
- Acceptance prompts: Tom and I will upload 30 representative prompts + two edge-case sequences by Thursday end of day.
- Environment: we'd prefer a hosted sandbox initially; if we need the private/VPC tests we'll escalate to our infra team mid-week 1.

One ask: could you include a short example of a streaming call with tool-calling in the SDK doc? Our engineers want a concrete example showing how to call an external enrichment webhook from within a response generation flow.

We'll also need a short note on how Redwood handles request-level routing in case we need to pin requests to a lower-latency region.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

—Emma

Senior Product Manager, Integrations | StratusGrid

Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed POC plan — technical integration notes

Emma / team —

Quick technical follow-up with concrete integration steps and the SDK examples you requested. See attached redwood_sdk_routebook.md for full snippets; key items inline below.

1) SDK + language support\- Python and Node are the fastest path for your stack. We include examples for both in the attachment.

2) Routes & endpoints (examples)\- /v1/generate (sync text generation)\- /v1/stream (server-sent events / chunked streaming for low-latency responses)\- /v1/tool-call (synchronous tool invocation hook from model output)

3) Streaming + tool-calling pattern\- kickoff streaming request to /v1/stream with tools=["enrich-webhook"] in the payload. Redwood will emit intermediate tokens and, when a tool call is triggered by the model, POST to your provided enrichment webhook with the tool payload. Example flow in attachment.

4) Recommended runtime config for the POC\- Model: distilled-rlf-4b (balances latency & quality).
- Batch size: 8 concurrent requests for typical 512-token flows.
- KV caching: enable prefix caching for repeated prompts / conversational context.
- Fallback policy: if queued latency >200ms switch to distilled-rlf-3b.

5) Performance & observability\- We'll provide a per-token latency dashboard and the eval harness that runs your 30 prompts and edge cases. Expect three traces per failure for debugging.

6) Sample curl (streaming + tool-call)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -d '{ "model":"distilled-rlf-4b", "prompt":"<...>", "tools":["enrich-webhook"], "stream":true }'

7) Test data & security\- If you opt for hosted sandbox, we will enforce ephemeral logs retention for the POC and provide a data-deletion runbook. For VPC/private testing we'll agree on KMS key usage.

Owners & timeline (refresh)\- Diego: technical runbook and daily stand for engineering handoff.\- Ben: billing & test credits issuance.\- Marissa: SOW finalization and signatures.

Milestones (condensed)
- Aug 1 kick: sandbox credentials + SDK build (day 0)\- Aug 2–6: SDK integration + stream/tool-call smoke tests\- Aug 7–13: Load + eval runs (two windows)\- Aug 14–15: Acceptance review & metrics signoff

I've attached the SDK routebook and an integration sketch. Please review and tell me if the runtime knobs need to be tuned to match your baseline.

Best,
Diego
